name: Hasegawa Hirano
source:
A member of "Genius 4".
A polite and calm girl who can deal a sleep-inducing karate chop. Since Hirano is literally a genius in that field, she is in charge of close combat in G4. Hirano always carries a lacrosse stick with her for some reason.

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/探偵オペラ_ミルキィホームズの登場人物]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url] and taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Genius_4]Wikipedia[/url].]
